Brent crude futures fell $1.43, or 1.30%, to $108.43 ​a barrel by 2340 GMT after settling at its highest since May ​19 on Friday. US West Texas Intermediate crude was at $100.88 a ⁠barrel, down 53 cents, or 0.52%. Trump signed an executive order on Friday waiving ​key sanctions and tariffs under the law known as the Graham Act, which ​he signed last month at the urging of lawmakers who want to pressure Moscow over its war in Ukraine. title: Gold prices remain unchanged in Pakistan
summary: Gold prices in Pakistan saw no change on Monday in line with the trend in the international market. In the local market, gold price per tola remained at Rs439,036. Similarly, 10-gram gold was sold at Rs376,402 with zero change to its price a day ago, according to rates shared by the All-Pakistan Gems and Jewellers Sarafa Association (APGJSA). On Saturday, gold price per tola reached Rs439,036 after a decline of Rs1,600 during the day. The international rate of gold remained unchanged at $4,165 per ounce.
